title: 2 Pack Wide Mouth 1 Gallon Clear Glass Jar with Lid, Heavy Duty Airtight Screw Lid with Silicone Gasket - Large Mason Jar with 2 Scale Mark for Fermenting Kombucha and Storing Food(Extra 2 Gaskets)
description:
About this item
Glass
[Wide Mouth and Easy to Clean] - With a generous 4.3-inch (10.9 cm) wide mouth, this jar is perfect for all your storage needs! It's wide enough to fit a measuring cup, making it super convenient for storing rice, pasta, cereal, coffee beans, oatmeal, and more. Plus, it's easy to get your hand in there for a cleaning, and it's dishwasher-safe
[Airtight and Reusable Lid] - Our airtight lid is thick and durable, featuring a silicone gasket that ensures a perfect seal. It's rust-proof and easy to clean, making it ideal for storing cider, sun tea, kombucha, limoncello, and more. Keep your food fresher for longer
[2 Types of Measurement Marks] - Each set includes two 1-gallon storage jars, a pen, and two wooden tags. You can switch up the contents whenever you need! The jars have two types of measurement marks, making it easy to see how much is left at a glance
[Space-Saving Design] - These large canning jars measure 6.2’’ x 6.2’’ x 10” and are perfect for storing flour, sugar, oats, and cookies. The square design fits neatly into cabinets, kitchens, shelves, and countertops, helping you save both money and space
[Large Capacity] - With a 1.1 gallon (4200 ml) capacity, this pickle jar can hold about two dozen eggs. It's great for small-batch pickling of cucumbers, making kimchi, sauerkraut, and more. Perfect for daily use and keeping your kitchen tidy

reviews_5s: Love it the kids are air tight. For rice & pasta is what I'm using it for. I don't believe it's water tight, from cleaning it and tipping it upside down with water in it. A little was coming out. But it's air tight so that great for me. Love the glass not to heavy and the lids are wonderful love the screw top. So much easier for someone with weak hands. To open and close. Lid is wide so I might be harder for someone else but I personally don't mind it. I plan on ordering more. Very happy with them.Perfect for our purpose. Just the right size for fermenting chicken feed for our egg laying hens. Fast and careful shipping. All pros and no cons. A++These are sturdy and works great for storage. Quality is excellent.Quality glass and lidsBest Jars ever.Great item for making pickles!Perfect, just what its supposed to be!Came well packed and in perfect condition!Extra seals and tags so you can label it.
reviews_1s:
Within a month of using these to store dog food in they bumped together and the whole bottom corner shattered! I lost all the dog food because the glass was honestly as thin as paper and couldn’t risk missing a piece. They look sturdy so I was shocked at how insanely thin the bottom corners were!I didn’t like this. I couldn’t open it.It smells horrible. I am not sure that its actually food safe.I got my glasses and one of them were completely smashed .Obviously not for boiling water! Making pickles. Poured boiling water over cucumbers and the jar cracked!
Directions say good for canning. Money back please!I wanted these to store my rice in and I was so excited. It came with extra seals for the lid and everything. But the glass is rather thin. And when simply washing and rinsing one of them broke. They are extrememly fragile. I wouldn't recommend.Nice big jars but one of them came with a major chip in it which is disappointing given they are not cheap.
